source.profile: Existing source receipt identifies the exact Model (DWG handle 0x22) and Layout1 (0x59), rooted ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary, reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD links, extension dictionaries/XRECORDs, and viewport targets: docs/research/p4-ac1024-layout-output-qualification-2026-10-31.json.

authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files
authority.scope: Dictionary parent, reactor, extension-dictionary, and item references retain distinct handle roles. The local parser's common-link validation marker is set only after the bounded versioned tail and dictionary item handles pass decoding and role checks.

finding.before: After S26, strict AC1024 conversion remained at 226/228 opaque callback qualifications. The debug finalizer printed remaining decimal handle values 34 and 89, corresponding to DWG handles 0x22 and 0x59 (Model and Layout1, type 82).
finding.cause: prepareDwgLayouts rejected the AC1024 ACAD_LAYOUT root dictionary and its per-layout extension dictionaries whenever hasDwgCommonLinkTail() was true. For AC1024, DICTIONARY parsing sets that marker after validating the common handle stream and counted entry-handle roles, so the unconditional false predicate blocked an already source-backed graph.
finding.after: The LAYOUT root and extension dictionary gates now require the common-link marker to equal the source-version expectation: false for the admitted AC1015/AC1018 legacy routes and true for AC1021/AC1024 R2007+ routes. Exact rooted keys, owner/reactor roles, LAYOUT fields, reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD links, extension XRECORDs, and viewport targets remain checked. The physical selector passes ASCII/Binary readback and same-adapter refusal/retry. Strict whole-file AC1024 conversion now exits successfully for this exact input.

implementation.productionChange: Use the parser's version-qualified DICTIONARY tail validation state for the rooted ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary and each admitted layout extension dictionary. Split the root marker from the other source-shape checks so debug mode reports its own gate.
implementation.selectorChange: Run the physical LAYOUT output through the same importing dx_iface, as dwg2dxf does. Test a corrupted paper-space BLOCK_RECORD handle against a sentinel destination, restore it, retry on the same adapter, and freshly read back both layout records and the selected graph.

physicalSelector.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary. Fresh readback checks Model/Layout1 plot and layout fields, ACAD_LAYOUT membership, BLOCK_RECORD backlinks, extension dictionary/XRECORD ownership, and last-active target roles. The injected invalid BLOCK_RECORD handle is refused while preserving the sentinel; correcting it and retrying on the same adapter succeeds.

strictCli.result: PASS; strict CLI exits 0 and publishes the DXF only after complete opaque-callback output qualification.

limits: This restores the exact previously source-profiled AC1024 Model/Layout1 graph; it does not qualify other LAYOUT profiles or other DWG versions.
The strict output is a local conversion result and has not been accepted by a native FreeCAD/LibreCAD GUI or independently evaluated for all drawing semantics.
No package gate or broad DWG/DXF support claim is promoted by this receipt.
next: Continue the remaining active source, authority, independent-reader, and native-platform gates. Preserve the strict CLI fail-closed behavior for profiles that lack this exact source evidence.
